issues.description: Constructor parameter order mismatch for class Lecture. The problem statement explicitly instructs that the constructor must follow the attribute order from the UML: (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors) (see problem_statement.md line 20 and UML attribute list). The solution implementation defines the constructor with the parameter order (String lectureName, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents) (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 13). This inconsistency between the specification and the reference implementation can confuse students about the expected constructor signature and lead to failing automated checks or mismatches when students follow the written instructions.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor parameter order consistent with the problem statement UML: change the solution constructor signature to public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) and assign fields accordingly. If the alternate order in the solution was intentional, instead update the problem statement and template to explicitly document the alternate parameter order so students are not misled.
